culprit_citations.quoted_text: Dispatch Acquisition Holdings, LLC (5) | Unitranche First Lien Revolver | S + 475 , 75 Floor | 8.42 % | 11/2032 | 1,673 | 1,627 | 0.3 | 1,627

findings.detail: The rule context used total investments of 879,592 as the denominator, but the source column is Percentage of Net Assets and ties to net assets of 465,069.

rationale: The flagged pct_of_net_assets_identity rows are not source data errors. The filing labels the SOI column as Percentage of Net Assets and reports total net assets of 465,069; the Dispatch row fair value of 1,627 divided by 465,069 is about 0.35%, which rounds to the printed 0.3%. The schedule also reports Total Investments of 879,592 at 188.9% of net assets, showing total investments is not the denominator for per-row percentage of net assets. The flag therefore comes from applying the wrong anchor/check denominator, not from an incorrect extracted position value.
